what: Feature 017 guard golden (research R13 G3; FR-017, SC-006): digests of every kit 31203 output of the 8 bundled recipes x combinations A, B, C, built from the dataset fixtures (tests/fixtures/datasets, via the fixture_registry fixture) and from each recipe's bytes before its sticker block: layout JSON and report JSON (generated_at fixed to 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z), preview PNG bytes and decoded pixels, parts lists (full and one kit), BrickLink XML and Rebrickable CSV (full and one kit; null when nothing is to buy), parts estimate JSON on the synthetic price fixture (tests/fixtures/prices/bricklink_price_guide.json, as of 2026-12-05), section counts JSON and cells.json; plus the sheets PDF (Letter) bytes and every sheets SVG page of land-elevation and ocean-sst in A.
